structured_output.title: Certificate IP address handling fix may affect this deployment
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with active Certificate resources (CRD `certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]` installed and `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` in use). The v1.18.0 fix changes how IP addresses in certificate `commonName` fields are handled—they will now go to `ipAddresses` instead of DNS `subjectAlternativeName`. Inspect your Certificate manifests to check whether any define IP addresses in `commonName`; if they do, review the fix details to confirm the new behavior meets your requirements.
